plan.title: Order Activity records Create New Version

steps.note: Open the eRFX creation flow for a test event.
Enable event versioning as required for the amendment action.
Apply the first available template before adding line items.
Add the required event line item.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Add the available QA test vendor so the event can be published.
Publish the test event that will be versioned.
Confirm the original event reached its project page.
Create the new version whose activity should be recorded.
Commit the copied version's schedule before publishing it.
Publish the new version so the version-creation action is recorded on the event history.
Confirm the new version reached its project page.
Open the stage Settings menu's Order Activity drawer.
Verify the activity drawer contains the Create New Version entry.
